name: Lune
source:
"I go wherever I feel like going, I do whatever I feel like doing, I proceed naturally however I feel like. That's what freedom is."

A hunter who travels freely without making connections with people.
He doesn't like mixing with people, but because of the guidance of the wind he starts traveling together with Thumbelina.
A guy who is hard to understand that goes at his own pace.
